# Find where streaming.py was written
write_streaming = await CONTEXT.search("streaming.py")
for item in write_streaming['items']:
    offset = item['offset']
    snippet = await CONTEXT.read(max(0, offset-50), 200)
    if 'write' in snippet or 'Write' in snippet:
        print(f"Offset {offset}: {snippet[:200]}")
